title: United Nations
text: The United Nations (UN) is an intergovernmental organization established on October 24, 1945, to promote international cooperation. The headquarters is in New York City, and the organization has six official languages: Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian, and Spanish. The UN has 193 member states and serves as a forum for dialogue between nations. Its main purposes are maintaining international peace and security, protecting human rights, delivering humanitarian aid, promoting sustainable development, and upholding international law.
